label: cap1
engineNote: capture-only: statements are captured on the H2 test context (transport only); back-to-table attribution evidence comes from the temporary MySQL container run, not from H2 timing or H2 EXPLAIN.
dataRule: 不登录（无 users 行；myScore 不读 users）；exams 行直插 id=930000000+n、status=4/published=1、paper_id=930000001(占位无外键)；exam_submissions 逐份直插 exam_id=930000000+n、status=3(已批改)、grading_status=1、total_score=objective_score=score(i)=BigDecimal.valueOf(400+(i*7919)%300, 1)（值域 40.0–69.9、300 个取值，大量并列且全非 null）、subjective_score=0.0；student_id=930000000+n*100000+i（全部合成；本人取下标 0，对应本人分=40.0=全场最低分）。paper_json/answers 保持 NULL（同既有 IT 口径；生产已批改行这两列非空、行更宽，回表代价只高不低，故本测量对候选收益的估计偏保守）。
captureMechanism: StatementHandler.prepare interceptor reading the final BoundSql + DefaultParameterHandler-equivalent value resolution; no hand-written SQL.

statements.sql: SELECT id,title,description,paper_id,course_id,class_id,parent_exam_id,makeup_score_rule,start_time,end_time,duration_minutes,allow_late_minutes,status,published,force_end,anti_cheat_config,snapshot_id,version,created_by,created_time,updated_time FROM exams WHERE id=? AND is_deleted=0

SELECT  id,exam_id,student_id,submit_time,answers,status,objective_score,subjective_score,total_score,grading_status,grading_error,partial_graded,version,created_time,updated_time  FROM exam_submissions      WHERE  (exam_id = ? AND student_id = ?)
SELECT COUNT( * ) AS total FROM exam_submissions      WHERE  (exam_id = ? AND status = ? AND total_score IS NOT NULL AND total_score > ?)
SELECT COUNT( * ) AS total FROM score_review      WHERE  (exam_id = ? AND student_id = ? AND status IN (?,?))

countStatement.sql: SELECT COUNT( * ) AS total FROM exam_submissions      WHERE  (exam_id = ? AND status = ? AND total_score IS NOT NULL AND total_score > ?)
countStatement.literalSql: SELECT COUNT( * ) AS total FROM exam_submissions      WHERE  (exam_id = 930000050 AND status = 3 AND total_score IS NOT NULL AND total_score > 40.0)
